title: Captured-pointer Firefox workaround re-types any matching pointer_up as a left-button release
reason: Reports a Firefox-specific recovery path rewriting a later right/middle-button release as a left-button release when the original captured left-button release was lost. No discussion was available.
assessment: Varve does not rewrite a pointerup button based only on a captured pointer id. Its input pipeline checks `button` at pointerdown and keeps contact ownership separately; the exact Firefox workaround and stale capturedPointerId path are not present.

title: Let custom shapes opt in to label-first hit testing instead of hard-coding note, arrow and hollow geo
reason: Requests an opt-in shape utility hook for label-first hit testing instead of hard-coding note, arrow, and hollow-geo types. This changes the upstream custom-shape extension API and overlap priority.
assessment: Varve does not expose the same pluggable ShapeUtil/custom-shape registry; its shape and text hit testing are implemented against its own scene-node model. The requested extension hook has no direct API counterpart.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not expose the same pluggable ShapeUtil/custom-shape registry; its shape and text hit testing are implemented against its own scene-node model. The requested extension hook has no direct API counterpart.

title: Let child shapes opt out of frame clipping instead of exempting the arrow type by name
reason: Requests a child-side custom-shape opt-out from frame clipping rather than exempting arrows by package type. No comments were available.
assessment: The issue depends on tldraw frame-like ShapeUtil inheritance and external custom connector types. Varve has no equivalent custom ShapeUtil extension boundary, so the proposed API does not transfer directly.

varveAssessment.assessment: The issue depends on tldraw frame-like ShapeUtil inheritance and external custom connector types. Varve has no equivalent custom ShapeUtil extension boundary, so the proposed API does not transfer directly.

title: Custom shapes that use editor component contexts are silently dropped from exports
reason: Reports an upstream SVG export provider missing component contexts, causing custom React shape components to throw inside an error boundary and disappear silently.
assessment: Varve exports serialized scene/IR nodes through engine serializers and renderers; it does not ask arbitrary React shape components to render inside SVG export. This provider-context failure path is not shared.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve exports serialized scene/IR nodes through engine serializers and renderers; it does not ask arbitrary React shape components to render inside SVG export. This provider-context failure path is not shared.

title: Make PerformanceManager extend EditorManager
reason: Requests adoption of the upstream EditorManager disposal contract for PerformanceManager while acknowledging that subscriber-driven lazy listeners need separate attach/detach handling.
assessment: The tldraw manager base class and lazy listener ownership model are package-specific; no direct class migration is indicated in Varve.

varveAssessment.assessment: The tldraw manager base class and lazy listener ownership model are package-specific; no direct class migration is indicated in Varve.

title: Timers never prunes fired or cleared timer ids, so editor.timers grows without bound
reason: Reports tldraw Timers retaining every fired or cleared timer ID for the editor lifetime, with repeated array copies making timer registration quadratic. No discussion was available.
assessment: Varve has no comparable editor-wide timer registry accumulating IDs. In the canvas input pipeline, lifecycle timers are held in individual refs, cleared/replaced, and nulled on fire or effect cleanup. This exact unbounded collection and quadratic append path is absent.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no comparable editor-wide timer registry accumulating IDs. In the canvas input pipeline, lifecycle timers are held in individual refs, cleared/replaced, and nulled on fire or effect cleanup. This exact unbounded collection and quadratic append path is absent.

title: Extract a shared helper for the repeated TLShapeId[] | TLShape[] to ids normalisation in Editor.ts
reason: Requests centralizing a repeated TLShapeId[]/TLShape[] normalization helper in upstream Editor.ts; the described issue is maintenance drift rather than an observed user-facing failure.
assessment: Varve’s selection-arrangement and scene APIs consume node IDs through their own document model. The TypeScript union and 22 repeated upstream conversion sites have no direct equivalent.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve’s selection-arrangement and scene APIs consume node IDs through their own document model. The TypeScript union and 22 repeated upstream conversion sites have no direct equivalent.

title: Deduplicate the axis-specific gap snapping code in BoundsSnaps
reason: Reports duplicated horizontal/vertical gap-snap logic in the tldraw SDK that had already drifted in boundary and duplicate-gap behavior; the requested follow-up is structural deduplication.
assessment: Varve’s snapping is already implemented in a dedicated module with shared axis-aware helpers, and existing snapping tests exercise horizontal and vertical behavior. No matching pair of duplicated 130-line gap algorithms was identified; avoid a speculative refactor of the interaction path.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve’s snapping is already implemented in a dedicated module with shared axis-aware helpers, and existing snapping tests exercise horizontal and vertical behavior. No matching pair of duplicated 130-line gap algorithms was identified; avoid a speculative refactor of the interaction path.

title: Table-drive the modifier key debounce handling in Editor.ts
reason: Requests table-driven modifier debounce handling after duplicated Shift/Alt/Ctrl/Meta paths diverged in key naming and special cases. The issue is upstream refactoring with potential input semantics.
assessment: Varve uses a different normalized keyboard-input pipeline and does not carry the four tldraw Editor timeout fields/method copies. No direct refactor is indicated.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve uses a different normalized keyboard-input pipeline and does not carry the four tldraw Editor timeout fields/method copies. No direct refactor is indicated.

title: Share the translate-by-page-delta helper across the layout commands in Editor.ts
reason: Requests centralizing repeated page-space translation and axis mapping across seven tldraw layout commands; the duplication has a repeated TODO but no direct defect claim.
assessment: Varve’s align and distribute operations are already centralized in `packages/editor/src/scene/selectionArrangement.ts`, with an axis argument and shared geometry helpers. This upstream duplication pattern is already avoided in the matching local workflow.
